COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CRLR No. 315 of 2013
Hon 'b le Pan k aj Pu r oh it , J.
Ms. Akleema Parveen, learned counsel holding
brief of Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for the
revisionists.
2. Mr. Vikram Singh Dhapola, learned counsel
holding brief of Mr. Ramji Srivastava, learned
counsel for the respondents.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. This criminal revision has been preferred
against the judgment and order dated 31.08.2013,
passed by learned Additional Family Judge,
Rishikesh, District Dehradun in Case No. 67 of 2010,
"Smt. Rajeshwari Kothari and Others Vs. Shri
Parshuram Kothari", whereby the application filed by
revisionist no.1 i.e., Smt. Rajeshwari Kothari and her
daughter (Hema Kothari) under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
for maintenance has been dismissed and at the same
time, it was partly allowed for revisionist no.2
(Monika Kothari) by awarding the maintenance of
`2000/- per month from respondent no.2 - husband
i.e., Shri Parshuram Kothari.
5. The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on seeing
the possibility of reconciliation between the parties
vide order dated 03.11.2020 has referred the matter to
Mediation Centre, Rishikesh, District Dehradun for
mediation and directed the parties to appear before
the In-charge of Mediation Cell, Rishikesh, on

18.11.2020 for the purpose of exploring the
possibility of amicable settlement.
6. It appears from the record that the parties
appeared before the mediation centre, on 17.11.2020
and an agreement was entered into between the
parties in the mediation centre on the terms and
conditions enumerated in the compromise date
17.11.2020. The District Judge vide its Letter No.
1125/XV/2020 dated 18.11.2020 sent the report of the
mediator to this Court along with the documents as
well as the compromise entered into between the
parties.
7. Today, in the presence of both the learned
counsel for the parties, this Court perused the
compromise dated 17.11.2020 arrived at between the
parties.
8. In view of the compromise entered into
between revisionist no.1 - Smt. Rajeshwari Kothari
and respondent no.2 - Shri. Parshuram Kothari, the
criminal revision is hereby allowed in terms of the
compromise rendered hereinabove. The compromise
dated 17.11.2020 shall form part of this order.
 ( Pan k aj Pu r oh it , J.)
